audio.strategy: One lazy Web Audio context owns two Piano layer buses, six ordered per-layer effect units, shared post-reverb Rotary routing, layer levels, master gain, limiter, and one destination. Deterministic offline DSP mirrors the audible controls for rendered-audio verification.

notes: The isolated workspace supplied no redistributable acoustic-piano recordings. Grand, Upright, and Electric are bundled generated PCM plans, not recordings, and are never described as recorded samples.
This truthfully deviates from the Phase 2 hard gate requiring recorded sample sets; no provenance claim is fabricated.
All sound generation and processing is local and works without network access.
A PCM-loading/startup failure reports 'PCM library failed · synthesized playable fallback active' and continues through the synthesized path.

architecture.voiceOwnership: Input token owns independent A/B handles; layer disable, note-off, pedal-up, all-notes-off, disconnect, blur, and unmount release only the appropriate owned handles.

unsupported: Recorded acoustic sample assets (not present in the isolated inputs; generated PCM is used and labeled)
Piano size classes, INFO view, downloads, and preset library
Delay feedback-loop effects and Analog mode
Rotary close mic and stop angle
Organ, Program, and Synth engines (their panel controls remain decorative in Phase 2)
